2. Heard Sri Saiyad Iqbal Ahmed, learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Rizwan Ahamad, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 and Sri Padmakar Rai, learned AGA for the State.
3.

The instant application has been filed for quashing the charge sheet dated 28.03.2024 as well as summoning order dated 18.06.2024 including the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No.28918 of 2024, arising out of Case Crime No.82 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 323 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P.
Act and 3/4 Muslim Women Protection of Right on Marriage Act, 2019, Police Station Nagphani,
District Moradabad.

sentences.text: 1 that dispute between the parties is matrimonial in nature and both the parties have settled their dispute amicably and entered into compromise.
The aforesaid compromise dated 10.10.2024 is reduced in written compromise and also annexed at page 51 of the affidavit.
It has been requested that the impugned proceedings may be quashed on the basis of aforesaid compromise.
5. Though this fact has not been disputed by learned AGA but he has raised a preliminary objection that the aforesaid proceeding cannot be quashed on the basis of compromise.
The aforesaid compromise should be verified by the court below before quashing the impugned proceeding.
6. In view of the above, the applicants are directed to file original deed of the compromise before the court below within a period of 15 days from today.

On filing of such compromise, the court below will verify the same within a period of two months after summoning the parties and after verification, the court below will dispose of the impugned proceeding, in accordance with law.
7. For a period of two and half months or till verification of compromise, whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants in the aforesaid case.
8. However, the parties are at liberty to file a fresh application under Section 528 BNSS to quash the impugned proceeding on the basis of verified copy of compromise, if need arises.
9. With the aforesaid direction, the present application is disposed of.

Order Date :- 11.4.2025 A.Kr.
